posts.cooked:
Mine is going to be basically the opposite of Ronway's. Lots of DR, healing, and damage redirection; but very few ways of dealing damage. Getting down to 40 cards was hard.

I'm planning to be in Rhino form the entire game, giving me 1DR plus a power for card draw. I took nine other Naturalist cards that will let me heal, redirect, or add DR. Naturalist's base power will let me go right back into Rhino form, so if we need to destroy a card, it should be a prime candidate without hurting my setup too badly (unless I need it for redirection). Natural-Born Vigor for extra power usage (which turns into extra card draws or extra healing).

I took most of my cards from Scholar. All of the Mortal Form to Energies for counterpunching. Transmutive Recovery and Bring What You Need for card draw. Expect the Worst for DR. And a few others. I didn't take Alchemical Redirection, because I think Naturalist already has enough of that.

Not a lot from Haka. Enduring Intercession for lasting redirection. Ta Moko for DR. Dominion for card draw. Haka of Restoration will pair nicely with Mortal Form to Energy.

Most of the Tachyon cards that I took either boost card draw (Fleet of Foot, Pushing the Limits) or card play (HUD Goggles, Lightning Reflexes). I'll need the card draw to fuel Mortal Form to Energy and Haka of Restoration and the extra plays will help me get set up faster (and re-set up, assuming our villain is going to be taking out our ongoings/equipment pretty regularly). I threw in one Blinding Speed for good measure.
